announcement: Sleeping Guddi v0.3.0 is here with a built-in media player, live audio visualizers, and interactive road trip memories!
features: Built-in Media Player: Play music and videos directly in the app
Audio Visualizers: Spectrum bars, soundwaves, and vinyl turntable animations
3D Video Cards: Interactive card tilt and gloss reflections
Road Trip Gallery: Switch photos and tap for floating hearts
Smooth Scrubbing: Instant audio seeking with zero lag
Auto Cover Art: Adds high-res album art and tags to MP3s
